sources.name: Ofcom Connected Nations broadband coverage API products
facts: Broadband Coverage Basic allows up to 100 calls per minute and 50,000 requests per month
Broadband Coverage Premium allows up to 500 calls per minute and 150,000 requests per month
The API retrieves broadband coverage against postcodes
sources.access_guard: Subscription/authentication is required; this route was documented but not called under the no-account policy.
sources.limitation: Postcode API coverage does not establish exact title-parcel identity, completed installation or live provider order acceptance.
sources.access_and_licence: Official Ofcom developer portal; subscription and API terms apply

sources.name: OS Open Linked Identifiers technical specification
facts: Provides authoritative relationships between UPRNs, USRNs and TOIDs
Includes BLPU_UPRN_TopographicArea_TOID_5 among 11 relationship packages
CSV relationship packages include JSON product-version information
sources.access_guard: Open download route is preferred over the authenticated API.
sources.limitation: OS warns that source-feature versions may differ and a relationship may no longer be valid; version and confidence fields must be checked before parcel binding.
sources.access_and_licence: Official OS OpenData documentation; Open Government Licence files included

sources.name: OS Linked Identifiers API authentication and identifier endpoint
facts: OS APIs require an API project and project key or OAuth2 token
Identifier queries can return associated identifiers
The API is an OpenData product but requests still require authentication credentials
sources.access_guard: No OS Data Hub account or API key was created or requested; downloadable open tables remain the safe path.
sources.limitation: An identifier relationship is not broadband serviceability and does not by itself prove equivalence to a registered title polygon.
sources.access_and_licence: Official OS API documentation; OS Data Hub account/key and API terms apply

sources.name: OS Open TOID
sources.published_or_updated: Current product page verified 31 July 2026; updated every six weeks
facts: TOIDs identify features found in OS MasterMap products
TOIDs are never reassigned to a different feature
Open product supplies generalised locations in CSV and GeoPackage
sources.access_guard: Free download product; no paid geometry was used.
sources.limitation: A generalised TOID location is not an exact title boundary and does not establish broadband coverage or orderability.
sources.access_and_licence: Free OS OpenData product; licence and attribution apply

sources.name: National Statistics UPRN Products (NSUL and ONSUD)
sources.published_or_updated: Official product page verified 31 July 2026; products released every six weeks
facts: NSUL allocates current GB addresses to Output Areas using UPRN and point-in-polygon methodology
ONSUD allocates UPRNs directly to administrative, health and other geographies
Both products are supplied in CSV with user guides
sources.access_guard: Open Geography downloads are suitable for geography QA, subject to product licensing.
sources.limitation: Statistical-geography allocation does not identify a title parcel or prove broadband serviceability.
sources.access_and_licence: Official ONS products; stated licensing conditions apply

sources.name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE technical guidance for GML files
facts: INSPIRE geometry is captured against British National Grid
Data can be converted from EPSG:27700 to web-map coordinate systems
HMLR warns reprojection calculations may shift some features by up to 15 metres
sources.access_guard: No spatial join is promoted without retaining source CRS and recording transformation parameters.
sources.limitation: Reprojected overlap or proximity cannot alone prove parcel-to-UPRN identity.
sources.access_and_licence: Official HM Land Registry technical guidance

sources.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons spatial data
sources.published_or_updated: Dataset published 5 July 2026; monthly publication cycle
facts: Shows indicative position and extent of registered freehold properties in England and Wales
Boundary polygons can appear in more than one local-authority file
The extent of a registered title cannot be established from INSPIRE polygons alone
sources.access_guard: Duplicate-boundary and tenure filters are mandatory before any spatial QA.
sources.limitation: Leasehold and other tenures may be absent; exact title extent requires the individual title plan.
sources.access_and_licence: Open Government Licence; HM Land Registry conditions apply

sources.name: OS Open UPRN technical specification
facts: Contains the position and UPRN for each record held within AddressBase Premium
Supports linking datasets by UPRN or address-point position
Can be used in GIS and spatial databases
sources.access_guard: Point coordinates are retained as address-location evidence only.
sources.limitation: An address point is not a parcel polygon and does not establish title ownership or broadband availability.
sources.access_and_licence: Official OS OpenData documentation; product licence and attribution apply
